object_description: narrow longitudinal five-story block with two access cores
design_condition: The narrow block is set back from the river and moderately from the street, creating a generous river landscape, connected forecourt, and relaxed street-side delivery and parking areas.

positive.statement: The careful landscape planning creates a varied sequence of recreational and outdoor spaces with high usage value.
The generous distance from the river mitigates the relationship between building length and height.
The school takes a self-confident position in relation to its surroundings.
The two consistently connected vertical axes are arranged in an operationally advantageous manner.
The urban integration of the striking school is a notable contribution in harmony with the external spatial qualities.
The consolidation into one building is impressive despite its considerable length and height.

negative.statement: The horizontal zoning and lack of openings across floors provide little exchange between departments.
The even horizontal facade structure is not entirely understandable given the partly over-high ground floor.
The structural rigor leads internally to a somewhat schematic and less collective school operation.
